import { harness } from "./harness.mjs";
const h = await harness("i-errors");
const { createNotificationsModule } = await import("./i-errors.ts");
const settings = h.createStore({ quietHours: "22-7", theme: "light" });
const m = h.module("notifications");
let product;
await h.step("the factory", async () => { product = await createNotificationsModule({ settings: settings.readonly(), errors: h.errorsPort }, m.context); });
if (product !== undefined) {
  const hours = () => product.instance.quietHours();
  h.check(hours().from === 22 && hours().to === 7, "the notifier does not start with the current quiet hours");
  settings.set({ quietHours: "23-6" });
  await h.settle();
  h.check(hours().from === 23 && hours().to === 6, "a valid change was not applied");
  const before = h.hostErrors.length;
  settings.set({ quietHours: "25-99" });
  await h.settle();
  const reports = h.hostErrors.slice(before);
  h.check(hours().from === 23 && hours().to === 6, "an invalid value replaced the last valid quiet hours");
  h.check(reports.length === 1, `an invalid value must reach the Host error port once; it arrived ${reports.length} times`);
  h.check(reports[0]?.source === "settings", "the invalid value was not reported by the settings store (was the report built by the module?)");
  h.check(typeof reports[0]?.subscription === "string" && reports[0].subscription.length > 0, "the report of the invalid value does not name the subscription");
  h.check(typeof reports[0]?.revision === "number" && reports[0].revision > 0, "the report of the invalid value does not carry the revision");
  h.check(reports[0]?.cause instanceof RangeError, "the report of the invalid value does not carry the parse failure unchanged");
  settings.set({ quietHours: "21-8" });
  await h.settle();
  h.check(hours().from === 21 && hours().to === 8, "a valid change after an invalid one was not applied");
  const status = product.capabilities["acme/notifications/status"];
  h.check(status.read(["muted"]).values.muted === false, "muted does not start as false");
  h.check(typeof status.set !== "function", "other modules can write the status store");
  const other = h.module("other");
  h.follow(status, other.scope.resources, ["muted"], "other/throws", () => { throw new Error("other failed"); });
  const beforeMute = h.hostErrors.length;
  await h.step("mute(true)", () => { product.capabilities["acme/notifications"].mute(true); });
  await h.settle();
  h.check(status.read(["muted"]).values.muted === true, "mute(true) did not reach the status store");
  h.check(h.hostErrors.slice(beforeMute).some((r) => r.subscription === "other/throws"), "a failure of another module's handler on the status store did not reach deps.errors.report");
  await other.scope.control.close();
  const report = await m.scope.control.close();
  h.check(report.complete, "closing the module scope did not complete");
  h.check(h.stats(settings).live === 0, "a subscription is still registered after the module closed");
}
await h.finish();
